scope: Read-only semantic review of the fixed carrier-destination candidate packet. The JSON packet contains proposed carrier content only; this is not Current publication, runtime implementation, calculation execution, or stable-ID allocation.

checks.name: source_pins_and_d664_minimality
checks.evidence: All four live source hashes match. CA-D-664@3-draft retains the v2 Claim and Carrier constraints, differing only by the two destination-to-filename/location bindings (apart from the candidate body's frontmatter-boundary leading newline).

checks.name: mandatory_property_model
checks.evidence: All four new Requirement/Declaration candidates have exactly one active Subject. Container declarations require one Property and zero direct values; File admits exactly Name and Path; each leaf requires one string direct value and explicitly has zero immediate children. The admitted constraint extractor recognizes all eight new CFEL expressions without diagnostics.

checks.name: destination_meaning_and_delivery_scope
checks.evidence: The proposal states Name as the calculated full filename including extension and Path as the calculated containing directory relative to repository root; calculated values are stored in frontmatter. It preserves existing Carrier meaning, filename, and placement rules, and does not add an algorithm, format invariant, or runtime calculation syntax.

checks.name: proposal_markers_and_adoption_boundary
checks.evidence: The Specification Proposal links each of the four ID-free CA-R-draft carriers by unique full path and the CA-D-664 successor; it explicitly defers stable-ID allocation to promotion. Its Adoption section keeps runtime calculation, frontmatter population, and migration as separate work.
